question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

MIMIC
solution: The correct answer is '**Copy**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Mimic**' is '**Copy**'. • **Mimic**: to copy somebody’s behavior, movements, voice, etc. in an amusing way. (मज़ाक़िया ढंग से दूसरों की नक़ल उतारना) • *Example: He could **mimic **all the teachers' accents.* • **Copy**: something that is made to look exactly like something else. (प्रतिलिपि, नक़ल) • *Example: I kept a **copy** of the letter I wrote.* **Correct Answer:__** *Mimic.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Fail**: to not be successful in something. (असफल होना) • **Attempt**: to try to do something that is difficult. [(कोई कठिन कार्य) करने का प्रयत्‍न करना] • **Prevent**: to stop something from happening or to stop somebody from doing something. (किसी बात को होने न देना या किसी को कोई काम करने से रोक देना) 41:Tfa1, The erroneous part is **'as a live childlike actor'.**
